title: Travala Unveils AVA+ Partners, a New Route to Crypto Payments Powered by AVA
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Singapore, Singapore, October 29th, 2026] Crypto projects will be able to lock AVA to have their token accepted as payment on Travala. Travala, the Binance-backed crypto travel booking platform, today announced AVA+ Partners, a new program that will provide crypto projects with a route to having their token accepted as a payment […]
